visual_elements.description: Neural network diagram: Left side shows input dots feeding into three input nodes (circles with Σ). Middle hidden layer has green nodes (circles with Σ) labeled O_j. Right output layer has orange nodes (circles with Σ) labeled O_k feeding into boxes labeled Output 1, Output 2, Output m. Arrows show weights w_ji between input and hidden, w_kj between hidden and output. Activation function boxes labeled 'f' appear after summation nodes. Bias nodes shown as purple circles with '1'. Curved dashed arrows show error backpropagation paths from outputs. Far right vertical red bar labeled 'Error Error' points to Class 1, Class 2, Class m boxes.
